name: com.dailyancestor/daily-ancestor
title: Daily Ancestor
description: Words from old records and genealogy guides for reading historical documents.

tools.name: record_word
tools.description: Look up a word, abbreviation, occupation, old disease name, Latin or legal term found in old U.S. genealogy records (census, church, probate, land, death records) in the Daily Ancestor dictionary. Returns the meaning, the explanation and its sources, and a link to the full entry with an example from a real record.

word.description: Word or abbreviation as written, e.g. "consumption", "inst.", "relict", "yeoman"

tools.name: genealogy_guides
tools.description: Search Daily Ancestor (free, no account) for a guide: every U.S. census 1790 to 1950 (what each column asks), state guides, record guides (draft cards, naturalization, probate, land), family myths checked against records, handwriting lessons and calculators (birth date from a census age or a gravestone, Soundex, cousin chart, research plan). Returns the best pages with a short summary and a link.

tools.name: record_word_of_the_day
tools.description: Daily Ancestor's word of the day from old U.S. records, and the daily record to decode (a real scan, the same for everyone that day). Use for a genealogy society newsletter, a class warm up or a daily family history puzzle.
